egress.proxy_env: withheld on this transport: Gemini CLI 0.62.0 stops the Streamable HTTP handshake after initialize whenever NO_PROXY is set

sandbox.profile: sandbox-exec: outbound to loopback only, system resolver denied

egress.tradeoff: The proxy variables were withheld on this transport, so the egress sink could not see what the harness tried to reach. Egress was held instead by a sandbox-exec profile allowing outbound connections to loopback only, with the system resolver denied, and verified by a probe in the same profile. Nothing could leave the machine, but refused attempts are not listed by host.
